_doc: Single source of truth for the declarative Android Emulator desktop app (containers-cloud/android-emulator.nix). Profiles are GENERATED as forms × tiers (phone/tablet × light/full) — never a hardcoded list. `common_hw`/`tiers`/`forms` values are raw AVD config.ini keys, merged (common → tier → form; form wins) into each AVD's config.ini idempotently on `build.sh switch`. `provisioning` drives the idempotent post-boot adb steps run by the launcher.
_doc_resolution: Resolutions are deliberately modest because the Android emulator on this NixOS+Intel host renders guest OpenGL-ES via SwiftShader (SOFTWARE) — hardware GL won't engage for GLES, so per-frame cost scales with pixel count. 2560x1600 = 4.1M px → ~5s/frame (unusable); these sizes keep SwiftShader smooth. Bump them back up if/when hardware GLES works on this host.

provisioning._doc: Idempotent post-boot steps applied via adb each launch. system_dark → `cmd uimode night yes`. home_launcher set via `cmd package set-home-activity`. superapp_launcher_theme pre-seeds launcher_theme_prefs.xml (key `theme`) via `adb run-as` (debug APK). apps[] installed if the package is absent; apk path may use $HOME.
